TARGETED_TEST: Install service, kill python processes, verify Task Scheduler triggers restart.
REPRO_STEPS: 1. Install CourierMotor scheduled task via install_motor_service.ps1. 2. Reboot or logon to trigger task. 3. Task Scheduler runs start_motor.bat. 4. start_motor.bat launches python processes via 'start /B' and exits immediately. 5. Task Scheduler marks task as 'Ready' (completed successfully). 6. Kill the python process. 7. Task Scheduler does NOT restart it because the task already finished.
ROOT_CAUSE: start_motor.bat uses 'start /B cmd /c' which returns immediately. Task Scheduler is unaware of the long-running Python processes. Additionally, install_motor_service.ps1 fails to quote $scriptPath in New-ScheduledTaskAction, breaking if the path has spaces.
BUG: Scheduled Task monitoring disabled by async batch exit
RAW_EVIDENCE: start_motor.bat: start /B cmd /c .venv_service\Scripts\python.exe... -> exits instantly. install_motor_service.ps1: $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute  -> no quotes.
MINIMAL_FIX: Quote $scriptPath in .ps1 files. In start_motor.bat, do not use start /B. Alternatively, have the Scheduled Task run python directly, or use a blocking wrapper so the batch file remains 'Running' until the daemons die.
